svg.title: Identity card — Saksham Jagetiya
svg.desc: A hanging lanyard ID card for Saksham Jagetiya, AI & Analytics Engineer and Student based in Pune, India, with portrait, GitHub handle saksham-program, B.Tech CSE (AI & Analytics) and a barcode. The card drops in, settles with a damped pendulum swing, then keeps a gentle swing.
